legacy_cells.B: Probabilistic Model‐Based Malaria Disease Recognition System
legacy_cells.C: Rahila Parveen; Wei Song; Baozhi Qiu; Mairaj Nabi Bhatti; Tallal Hassan; Ziyi Liu
legacy_cells.S: Classify whether the input symptom and environmental data indicate malaria-positive or malaria-negative status.
legacy_cells.AI: Patient symptoms (clinical symptom variables); environmental/weather variables (rainfall, humidity, temperature)
legacy_cells.FM: The authors present a Bayesian-network classifier using patient symptoms and environmental information to predict malaria.
legacy_cells.FN: Test-set classification: accuracy 0.8100 (81%); sensitivity 0.9020; specificity 0.7143; F1 score 0.8288.
legacy_cells.FO: The authors state probabilistic BN inference is NP-hard in the worst case and CPT complexity grows exponentially with the number of parent nodes.
legacy_cells.FP: Future work: increase the dataset, consider other BN variants, and use IoT devices and sensors to collect symptom and environmental data.
legacy_cells.FR: The experiments demonstrate static malaria classification from symptoms and environmental data only. They do not demonstrate a persistent evolving patient state, temporal transition, treatment-conditioned rollout, identified causal effect, or planning/control; reported accuracy is not evidence of prospective clinical benefit.
legacy_cells.FX: Complete extracted PDF, all 11 pages: title/abstract (p. 1); introduction and related work (pp. 1–4); methods/data and BN design (pp. 4–7); results and Tables 1–2 (pp. 6–9); conclusion, future work, data availability and limitations (pp. 9–10); references (pp. 10–11). Relevant figures and tables were inspected in the extracted text. The OCR has minor character substitutions (e.g., 'The' rendered as '+e'); the reported values and relevant quotes above are legible. | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: The article proposes and tests a static Bayesian malaria classifier; it does not define or evaluate patient-state evolution or action-conditioned dynamics. No A:I values were changed. Evidence is limited to the supplied complete extracted text; no external sources were consulted. Evidence QA: 9/26 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (34.6%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 18 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 8 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.

limitations: All11pages/36references and all7figures/2tables read/visually inspected; all pages rendered. No appendix included.
Source text has character/spacing corruption; short quotes verified; diagrams/tables checked visually. Symptoms and weather variables discrete, exact binary thresholds/time linking unspecified.

p7 says81positive+19negative correctly classified yet reports81%accuracy; Table2 cells46/14/5/35 contradict prose. Several sensitivity/specificity/precision labels mismatch matrix orientation; retain raw metrics, no recomputation/relabeling.

Patient counts vs records, diagnosis gold standard details, sampling, dates, demographics, patient-wise independence, ethics/consent and IoT implementation unclear. R2 means reported internal record-heldout test only.
No prospective benefit, calibrated uncertainty or causal identification; cited systems not independently verified. Single-model source review, no independent human review/replication.
notes: Figures6/7 alter observed symptom/weather evidence, not settable clinical interventions or matched causal treatment comparisons. Static BN evidence propagation not filtering over time. R2 scoped100record internal test with reporting contradictions.
